pr_title: Search area: Fix bug where opening the search ASB for the first time would fail to move focus
pr_body:
Issue was that settings it's visibility for the first time resulted in a race condition where the focus was set before the rendering cycles necessary were finished.

This PR also renames "SearchReigon" to "SearchRegion" as this was a typo.

Fixes #2982
pr_comments: @chingucoding Great work! Oh, and nice catch with that typo 😂

issue_context.title: Search box doesn't put focus when opened first time via keyboard
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.
When opening a folder and open the search box for the first time, focus is not put on the search box for the first time. Closing the search box and reopening it will then put focus on the search box.
**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Open folder
2. Open search box using keyboard by hitting space/enter on search icon
3. Observe that focus is on button, not on search box

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
Focus should land consistently on search box (x)
![Gif showing how focus order moves back and forth and skips search box when opened for the first time](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16122379/104468714-0c155480-55b8-11eb-9b09-213da750c95f.gif)
or button
**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**
 - OS Version: Windows 10 10.0.19042
 - App version: 1.0.0

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here. Does this problem occur again after restarting the app?

**Log file**
Please upload the log file here so that we can understand your issue better. You can access it from Settings->About->Open log location. You can also find the log file manually by following [this](https://github.com/files-community/Files/wiki/Opening-the-log-file) guide.

comments: @chingucoding Thank you for opening this issue, do you want to try fixing this?
I'll take a look at this and see what I can find.

review_comments: Theoretically, we could also wait for one or two rendering ticks, but that would require a bit more code. This is easier to read and probably more robust.
I originally tried with a small delay, but it led to a bad experience, besides for needing less code, this is probably the better solution.
